title: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.30932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic recommendation pursues shopper goals through sequences of context-dependent decisions. Developing and evaluating such policies requires faithful recommendation world models that capture both the interactive shopping environment and users' behavioral responses over long interactions. Existing resources rarely provide long-horizon, fine-grained real-user trajectories or support trajectory-level evaluation and offline validation against production A/B results. We introduce UserArena, a real-world e-commerce interactive benchmark containing 64,729 session trajectories from 11,010 users, spanning 566,102 items and 13 action types. UserArena pairs these trajectories with an interactive environment and supports offline validation against outcomes from a controlled production A/B test, enabling five-level evaluation from output validity and local decisions to sequential behavior, personalization, and outcomes. translated_title: UserArena：面向长周期购物智能体的交互式用户模拟基准测试
translated_abstract: 智能体推荐通过一系列依赖上下文的决策来实现购物者目标。开发和评估此类策略需要忠实的推荐世界模型，既能刻画交互式购物环境，又能捕捉用户在长程交互中的行为反应。现有资源很少提供长周期、细粒度的真实用户轨迹，也难以支持轨迹级评估以及与生产环境A/B测试结果对照的离线验证。我们提出了UserArena，这是一个真实电商场景的交互式基准，包含来自11,010名用户的64,729条会话轨迹，涵盖566,102个商品和13种动作类型。UserArena将这些轨迹与交互式环境相结合，并支持与受控生产环境A/B测试结果对照的离线验证，实现了从输出有效性和局部决策到序列行为、个性化和最终结果的五级评估。为了提高模拟器的保真度……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: UserArena是一个包含6.4万余条真实用户会话轨迹的电商交互式基准，通过五级评估体系并对照生产环境A/B测试结果进行离线验证，用于开发和评估长周期购物智能体的推荐策略。
en_tdlr: UserArena is a real-world e-commerce interactive benchmark with 64,729 user session trajectories that enables five-level evaluation and offline validation against production A/B test results for developing and assessing long-horizon shopping agents.
